blocks.title: Vaults in rg-contoso-finance-prod — soft-delete inventory

rows.state: Soft-deleted (87d left)
Active

blocks.title: Recover soft-deleted vault instead of recreate
blocks.diff:
- # Fails: VaultAlreadyExists — name held by soft-deleted vault
- New-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod' -Location 'eastus'
+ # Verify soft-deleted state across vaults in the subscription
+ $deleted = Get-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState | Where-Object { $_.VaultName -eq 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' }
+ $deleted | Select-Object VaultName, ResourceGroupName, Location, DeletionDate, ScheduledPurgeDate
+ # Purge protection is enabled and data must be preserved — do NOT purge
+ # Recover the original vault with its secrets, keys, certs and policies
+ Undo-AzKeyVaultRemoval -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod' -Location $deleted.Location
+ # Verify recovery
+ Get-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod'
+ Get-AzKeyVaultSecret -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' | Select-Object Name, Enabled

blocks.title: Soft-deleted vault inventory — kv-contoso-fin-prod-01

rows.state: Soft-deleted — purge protection enabled, recoverable

blocks.title: Recover (not purge/recreate) the soft-deleted vault
blocks.diff:
- # Recreate fails: name already exists / reserved
- New-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod' -Location 'eastus'
+ # Verify soft-deleted state (purge protection blocks purge)
+ Get-AzKeyVault -InRemovedState | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' }
+ az keyvault list-deleted --query "[?name=='kv-contoso-fin-prod-01']"
+ # Recover the old vault to its original resource group (chosen strategy)
+ Undo-AzKeyVaultRemoval -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod' -Location 'eastus'
+ # Azure CLI equivalent:
+ # az keyvault recover --name kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 --resource-group rg-contoso-finance-prod
+ # Verify recovery
+ Get-AzKeyVault -VaultName 'kv-contoso-fin-prod-01' -ResourceGroupName 'rg-contoso-finance-prod'
+ az keyvault show --name kv-contoso-fin-prod-01 --resource-group rg-contoso-finance-prod --query properties.provisioningState

+Connect-MgGraph -Scopes "Application.ReadWrite.All,DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All"
+$apiSp  = Get-MgServicePrincipal -Filter "displayName eq 'Contoso MCP API'"
+$app    = Get-MgApplication -Filter "displayName eq 'Contoso MCP Client'"
+$scope  = $apiSp.Oauth2PermissionScopes | Where-Object Value -eq 'mcp.read'
-$access = @{ ResourceAppId=$apiSp.AppId; ResourceAccess=@(@{Id='<mcp.write-id>';Type='Scope'}) }
+$access = @{ ResourceAppId=$apiSp.AppId; ResourceAccess=@(@{Id='<mcp.write-id>';Type='Scope'},@{Id=$scope.Id;Type='Scope'}) }
+Update-MgApplication -ApplicationId $app.Id -RequiredResourceAccess @($access)
+$sp = Get-MgServicePrincipal -Filter "appId eq '$($app.AppId)'"
+New-MgOauth2PermissionGrant -ClientId $sp.Id -ConsentType AllPrincipals -ResourceId $apiSp.Id -Scope 'mcp.read mcp.write'
+Get-MgApplication -ApplicationId $app.Id | Select-Object -ExpandProperty RequiredResourceAccess

blocks.title: PowerShell 7 / Azure CLI — Purge soft-deleted vault, recreate, grant RBAC
blocks.diff:
- az keyvault create --name kv-contoso-fin-02 --resource-group rg-contoso-fin --enable-rbac-authorization false
+ # 1. Confirm conflict: az keyvault list-deleted --query "[?name=='kv-contoso-fin-02']" -o table
+ # 2. Purge soft-deleted vault (irreversible; use recover instead if old secrets must be kept)
+ az keyvault purge --name kv-contoso-fin-02 --location eastus
+ az keyvault create --name kv-contoso-fin-02 --resource-group rg-contoso-fin --location eastus --enable-rbac-authorization true --enable-purge-protection true --retention-days 90
+ $kv = az keyvault show --name kv-contoso-fin-02 --query id -o tsv
+ $oid = az ad user show --id 'lynne.robins.contoso@c4a8shili.onmicrosoft.com' --query id -o tsv
+ az role assignment create --assignee-object-id $oid --assignee-principal-type User --role 'Key Vault Secrets Officer' --scope $kv
+ az role assignment create --assignee-object-id $oid --assignee-principal-type User --role 'Key Vault Crypto Officer' --scope $kv
+ Start-Sleep -Seconds 60 # allow RBAC propagation
+ az keyvault secret list --vault-name kv-contoso-fin-02 -o table # verify as operator; have Lynne retry

recommendedActions.label: Stage Purge, Recreate & Grant RBAC

recommendedActions.command: az keyvault purge --name kv-contoso-fin-02 --location eastus && az keyvault create --name kv-contoso-fin-02 --resource-group rg-contoso-fin --location eastus --enable-rbac-authorization true --enable-purge-protection true --retention-days 90
